# Android version history
[![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/04/Android-17-wordmark-black.svg/500px-Android-17-wordmark-black.svg.png?utm_source=en.wikipedia.org&utm_campaign=parser&utm_content=thumbnail)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Android-17-wordmark-black.svg) [Android 17](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_17) is the current version of Android, released on June 16, 2026.

## Overview
| Name | Internal codename[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-Codenames-15) | Version number(s) | [API](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/API) level | Release date | Latest security patch date[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-20) | Latest [Google Play Services](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Google_Play_Services) version[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-21) (release date) |
|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| [Android Lollipop](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_Lollipop) | Lemon Meringue Pie | Unsupported: 5.0 – 5.0.2 | 21 | November 4, 2014[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-android.googlesource.com-23) | November 2017 | 24.28.35 (August 2024) |
| [Android Marshmallow](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_Marshmallow) | Macadamia Nut Cookie | Unsupported: 6.0 – 6.0.1 | 23 | September 29, 2015[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-gr-25) | August 2018 | 26.26.65 (July 2026) |
| [Android Oreo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_Oreo) | Oatmeal Cookie | Unsupported: 8.0 | 26 | August 21, 2017 | January 2021 |
| [Android Pie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_Pie) | Pistachio Ice Cream[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-26) | Unsupported: 9 | 28 | August 6, 2018 | January 2022 |
| [Android 10](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_10) | Quince Tart[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-VergeQR-27) | Unsupported: 10 | 29 | September 3, 2019 | February 2023 |
| [Android 11](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_11) | Red Velvet Cake[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-VergeQR-27) | Unsupported: 11 | 30 | September 8, 2020 | February 2024 |
| [Android 12](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_12) | Snow Cone | Unsupported: 12 | 31 | October 4, 2021 | March 2025 |
| [Android 12L](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_12L) | Snow Cone v2 | Unsupported: 12.1[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-A12.1-30) | 32 | March 7, 2022 |
| [Android 13](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_13) | Tiramisu | Unsupported: 13 | 33 | August 15, 2022 | February 2026 |
| [Android 14](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_14) | Upside Down Cake[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-31) | Supported: 14 | 34 | October 4, 2023 | August 2026 |
| [Android 15](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_15) | Vanilla Ice Cream[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-32) | Supported: 15 | 35 | September 3, 2024 |
| [Android 16](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_16) | Baklava[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-aufdto-33) | Supported: 16 | 36 | June 10, 2025 |
| [Android 17](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_17) | Cinnamon Bun[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-android17-4)[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_version_history#cite_note-34) | Latest version:17 | 37 | June 16, 2026 |

## Version history
### Android 12
Android 12 is the twelfth major version of the Android operating system.

### Android 16
Android 16 is the sixteenth major release of [Android](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Android_(operating_system)).
